notes.title: Play Party Pack 11 on October 23rd 2025 - Watch the Gameplay Trailer Now!
notes.notes:
[p][i]The Jackbox Party Pack 11[/i] is coming to all major platforms on October 23, 2025. Check out this brand new gameplay trailer to preview the fun:[/p][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="a8IwlJvXhgk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]Get ready to play 5 hilarious new party games:[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Doominate [/i](Writing): Take a perfectly lovely situation and destroy it in this head-to-head joke game where it feels so good to be so bad. Doominate supports 3-8 players.[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Hear Say[/i] (Sound Effects): Record sound effects and dialogue directly from your phone in a foley-inspired game where laughter is the soundtrack. Then, watch your voices come to life in a series of short movie clips! Hear Say supports 2-8 players. [/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Cookie Haus [/i](Drawing): Play our coziest and kookiest drawing game yet by fulfilling cookie design orders for unusual clientele. Don’t play on an empty stomach! Cookie Haus supports 3-8 players.[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Suspectives[/i] (Social Deduction): There’s been a crime, one player secretly did it, and the evidence comes from your own survey answers! Study the clues, defend your innocence (even if you’re lying), and put your friends on trial. Suspectives supports 4-8 players.[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Legends of Trivia [/i](Trivia): Assemble your team and put your trivia knowledge to the test in a fantastical world full of danger! Teamwork! Monsters! Do you dare take on one of the most challenging trivia games yet? Legends of Trivia supports 1-6 players.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Add Party Pack 11 to your [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364070/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_11/"][u]wishlist on Steam[/u][/url]![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Introducing the Fifth Game in Party Pack 11: Cookie Haus
notes.notes: [p]Welcome to [i]Cookie Haus[/i]! You’ve been hired as a cookie decorator for a bakery with an odd sort of clientele. Your job is to decorate cookies to their specifications… better than your fellow employees.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Kb0p6mUjApM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]You’ll be given a cookie to decorate. That cookie might look like a crescent moon, but the customer has asked for it to look like “America’s Ugliest Dogs.” [/p][p]It’s time to frost. Choose from a variety of colors and frosting sizes. Add some sprinkles for pizazz. Then, give it a title to illustrate your creative vision.[/p][p]Cookie designs will then be shown in matchups with other bakers. Vote on your favorites, and assign kudos to other bakery masterpieces.[/p][p]Ready to start your shift? Well, the bakery isn’t open just yet. Add [i]The Jackbox Party Pack 11[/i] to your wishlist on Steam to be first in line at this cursed cookie consortium. [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364070/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_11/" style="button"]WISHLIST PARTY PACK 11[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Introducing the Fourth Game in Party Pack 11: Hear Say
notes.notes: [p]Ahhhh! Ahhh. AAAAAAAAHHHHH. AHHHHHH!!!!!!!! Aaaahhhhh. [/p][p][/p][p]Oh, don’t mind me. I’m just warming up my pipes for a game of [i]Hear Say[/i], the fourth game in [i]The Jackbox Party Pack 11[/i]! Watch the teaser video for [i]Hear Say[/i] below.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="hv7eLDfQlmE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In [i]Hear Say[/i], you’ll be putting your pipes to work to create hilarious soundscapes. Use your phone as a controller, just like all Jackbox party pack games. But in this one, you get to use the microphone on your phone to get real sound effects that work in the game![/p][p]First, you and your friends will need to calibrate. You’ll be tasked with something simple like: get this dot above the line as many times as possible using just your voice. [/p][p]Then, you’ll receive prompts on your device. Something like: “make the noise of a balloon deflating.” If you’re playing in the same room as friends, or in an extra vivacious Discord server of mic-on players, be prepared for a ridiculous cacophony of sound! Record your sounds amidst the chaos or find a quiet spot in the corner to surprise everyone with your funny foley work.[/p][p]After everyone has recorded their sounds, they’ll be played back for everyone to hear and vote for their favorites. Once winners of each round have been selected, those sounds will be presented in a brand new context. That balloon deflating? Now it’s breaking the silence in a peaceful yoga studio.[/p][p]The beauty of this game? Anyone can be a star — from your most charismatic buddy in the group chat to the shyest friend at the function. [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364070/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_11/" style="button"]Wishlist The Jackbox Party Pack 11[/url][/p]

notes.title: Trivia Murder Party 3 has been delayed
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve made the decision to delay [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048060/Trivia_Murder_Party_3/"]Trivia Murder Party 3[/url] into 2026. [/p][p][/p][p]From the beginning, Trivia Murder Party 3 has been one of our most ambitious projects yet. The game is being built in a new engine and it will be our first Jackbox title in recent years with online matchmaking. It is also the first title we hope to continuously update with new events and content after its release. [/p][p][/p][p]We know how much the Trivia Murder Party franchise means to our fans and to our team. We are excited to collaborate with our players to help Trivia Murder Party 3 evolve and we want to create the best possible starting point. We know that can only be achieved by giving our staff the space, time, and work environment to do what they do best. [/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to bring the party to you next year. In the meantime, you can follow our progress on the Trivia Murder Party 3 Steam page and on our blog. We look forward to sharing more with you soon. Thank you for your patience with us and for your support of our games for so many years.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Jackbox Games[/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2][hr][/hr][h3]Want to stay up to date with the latest developments?[/h3][h2][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048060/Trivia_Murder_Party_3/" style="button"]Wishlist Trivia Murder Party 3[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Introducing The Second Game in Party Pack 11: Doominate
notes.notes:
You’ve been good, haven’t you? That’s why you deserve a little treat. You deserve some more information about the second game in Party Pack 11 (coming this fall… see the announcement [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/jackbox-direct-2025]here[/url]). 

Well, since you’ve been so good, we can tell you that this game is called Doominate. Sounds nice, doesn’t it? Oh, you don’t think a game with the word “doom” in it sounds nice? You might be onto something.

You see, in Doominate, you’re going to take something nice and mess with it 😈. It’s a twist on some of our classic joke writing games because instead of answering a prompt, you are building a narrative and trying to make your friends laugh by spoiling some of their favorite things.

Was your favorite thing wrecked by a friend? Don’t worry. In the final round, you’ll have an opportunity to attempt to un-wreck something. 

[previewyoutube=HVikLkT9llY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]How many people can play Doominate?[/b]

3-8

 
[b]Around how long does one game of Doominate take to play?[/b]

20 min 

 
[b]Will Doominate work with the Jackbox Megapicker?[/b]

If you are playing on Steam, all games in Party Pack 11 will work with the free Megapicker.

notes.title: The first game in The Jackbox Party Pack 11 is...
notes.notes:
Wow! Did you hear? [i]The Jackbox Party Pack 11[/i] is coming to all major consoles later in 2025 with five new games! 

“But, Jackbox,” you ask, “What are those five games?” Great question, disembodied curious voice!

The first game we are revealing from [i]The Jackbox Party Pack 11[/i] is [i]Suspectives[/i]! The other four games are currently a secret, [url=https://youtu.be/xV1s_4EXWG0?si=iGDpTClwqhi_82jE]but you can get some info about them in our Jackbox Direct![/url]

[previewyoutube=YT3BXNBp-xE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What is [i]Suspectives[/i]?[/h2]

[i]Suspectives[/i] is a social deduction game where your own quirky details become evidence in a crime! Each game of [i]Suspectives[/i] starts with some quick survey questions where every player answers questions ranging from topics like which boy band you think is the best and whether or not you can keep a houseplant alive (spoiler alert: my begonias are thriving).

The moment all answers are in, word goes out that (GASP) a crime's been committed, with one player being the secret criminal. And the only evidence to work with…? The very same answers to those surveys.

Grab your fedora and trench coat, because you and your fellow detectives need to work together to uncover which person the evidence points to with grueling interrogation sessions and lie detector reveals! And if you’re the criminal, try to blend in as a harmless detective by convincing everyone that you actually don’t have a favorite Beatle, despite that giant tattoo of Paul poking out beneath your sleeve.
[h2]
How many people can play [i]Suspectives[/i]?[/h2]
4-8 players can get their sleuth on.

[h2]Around how long does one game of [i]Suspectives[/i] take to play?[/h2]
About 10-15 minutes.

[h2]Will [i]Suspectives[/i] work with the Jackbox Megapicker?[/h2]
If you are playing on Steam, all games in Party Pack 11 will work with the free Megapicker.

notes.title: Megapicker Update 3
notes.notes:
We didn't get these out for the weekend, but they're here now.

[h3]Based on your feedback we've made some changes to filtering and sorting!
[/h3]
Owned and favorited games are weighted over unowned titles in the library.  This means when you filter, you'll always see games you own before anything else.

[h3]We've received a lot of feedback on confusion surrounding filters and what's actually happening, so we've added some visual cues to help clarify things.[/h3]
   - Advanced Filters will now show a count of the filters applied
   - Divider lines between items that perfectly match your filters and everything else
   - Library view returns to the top when you adjust filters

Library view now has the ability to sort by Alphabetical order instead of release date via a setting in Advanced Filters.

[h3]Fixed Issues:
[/h3][strike]- In some scenarios, games launch to the normal Party Pack loading screen as opposed directly to the title. We're actively investigating this one to better understand why. It will not have any impact on your game play, but we totally get it's pretty annoying.[/strike] -  FIXED!

[strike]- Some users are reporting issues with saved data from games like Zeeple Dome not loading when launching via The Megapicker. We are actively investigating this. [/strike] - FIXED!

[h3]Known Issues:
[/h3]- The Jackbox Party Packs 1 and 2 may not always launch in full screen. We're working on a fix for that. As a workaround, you can load the Party Pack by itself, change to fullscreen mode and exit. Subsequent launches via the Megapicker will be in full screen.

[h3]Next Up:
[/h3]- A fully localized build is working its way through QA!  We have some small UI elements to fix for our German friends, but hope to have it released within a week.
- Native gamepad / controller support is in active development.
- Past Games and Galleries accessible outside of jackbox.tv

[h2]Please continue to use that feedback button in The Jackbox Megapicker![/h2]

notes.title: Megapicker Weekend Update
notes.notes:
What a week!  The Jackbox Megapicker and a sequel to Fakin' It?!??!  We'll let's not stop there!

We've taken your feedback seriously and have updated The Jackbox Megapicker!

[h2]Filters now include duration, player count, and Party Pack![/h2]

Choose the number of folks you're playing with and see the games that fit your group with the new Player Count filter.

Squeeze a game in before you have to leave!.  Just use the Duration filter and adjust the min and max time to hone in on the perfect game for the time you have.

Filter by Pack.  Sure, the point of the Megapicker is to show all your games regardless of which Party Pack they're in, but sometimes you still want to see what's where.  The new Advanced Filter allows you to filter your games by which Party Pack they're in so you won't make the same mistake we did by putting Trivia Murder Party 2 in Party Pack 7.

[h2]This release also includes some general bug fixes and improvements[/h2]

Most notably:
- Some Windows users were unable to launch The Jackbox Megapicker a second time.  This bug has been fixed and the Megapicker will load every time.

- A small subset of Steam Deck users experienced a boot loop if they restarted their Steam Deck after launching The Jackbox Megapicker.  This has been resolved in the Megapicker.

- Properly attribute Trivia Murder Party 2 to Party Pack 6.  Woops!

[h3]Known issues:[/h3]
- In some scenarios, games launch to the normal Party Pack loading screen as opposed directly to the title.  We're actively investigating this one to better understand why.  It will not have any impact on your game play, but we totally get it's pretty annoying.  

- The Jackbox Party Packs 1 and 2 may not always launch in full screen.  We're working on a fix for that.  As a workaround, you can load the Party Pack by itself, change to fullscreen mode and exit.  Subsequent launches via the Megapicker will be in full screen.

- Some users are reporting issues with saved data from games like Zeeple Dome not loading when launching via The Megapicker.  We are actively investigating this.
